newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq's oil minister heads for Italy.
newsitem.headline: Iraq's oil minister heads for Italy.

text.p: Iraqi Oil Minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed has left for Italy on a trip expected to open a "new horizon" in economic relations, the official Iraqi News Agency (INA) said on Tuesday.
It said the visit was at the invitation of Italy's Minister of Industry Pierluigi Bersani.
INA quoted Rasheed as saying he would meet several Italian officials to "open a new horizon of economic and trade cooperation between Iraq and Italy."
It said Rasheed was leading an oil delegation to discuss "oil and industrial ties".
In February, Italy opened an interest section in Baghdad.
Iraq severed diplomatic ties with Italy and other Arab and Western countries which took part in the U.S.-led military coalition that drove Iraqi troops out of Kuwait in 1991.
Scores of Italian businessmen and traders have flocked to Baghdad recently to secure deals in the lucrative market. Italy was Iraq's fourth trading partner before the Gulf crisis.
